name: std::to_underlying

declarations.code:
template <class Enum>

constexpr std::underlying_type_t<Enum> to_underlying(Enum e) noexcept;

intro: Converts an enumeration to its underlying type. Equivalent to return static_cast<std::underlying_type_t<Enum>>(e);.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The integer value of the underlying type of Enum, converted from e.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text:
std::to_underlying can be used to avoid converting an enumeration to an integer type other than its underlying type.

guides.name: std::to_underlying
guides.summary: Get the number stored behind an enum value.
guides.analogy: Like reading the numeric code behind a named label.
guides.signature:
template<class T>
constexpr std::underlying_type_t<T> to_underlying(T value) noexcept;
guides.note: Only enumeration types are accepted. The returned type is the underlying type of that enum.
